concept.title: Mental health and peer support
concept.shortdesc: Support groups and emotional, practical and mental health support, including peer groups for people with shared experiences.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Attending regular groups where people meet for mutual practical and emotional support, including social and family support groups.
: Groups where people with shared experiences meet, in person or online, to support each other.
: General emotional support and combined emotional and practical help, including crisis and short-term support.
: Support with anxiety, stress, low mood, self-harm and emotional difficulties, including apps, face-to-face help and crisis assessment.
: Support, advice and information for people with mental health difficulties or wellbeing needs.
